span.p:
S_pers > 0 ?
beats the last observed value

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Do not deploy.
Persistence is cheaper and better.
Typical of high-inertia variables whose
autocorrelation time exceeds the horizon.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ship the climatology instead.
It is cheaper to compute, cheaper to serve,
and more accurate. Invisible if only S_pers
is reported.
Note: this does NOT mean the model is
merely seasonal — see the ablation branch.

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Beats both baselines.
Information beyond both the present state
and the seasonal cycle.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Mechanism: how much skill
survives removing calendar features ?

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Skill is not seasonal.
Whatever the model found, the calendar
is not carrying it. Typical even among
models that lose to climatology.

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Seasonally dominated.
A day-of-year lookup reproduces most of
the skill. Can occur even when the model
beats climatology, so S_clim will not
reveal it.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Does it transfer to
a held-out site ?

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Interpolation, not transfer.
Pooled metrics overstate what a user
clicking unseen ocean will get.
Restrict to trained sites, or say so.

div.style: color: rgb(26, 26, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Transfers within the sampled regimes.
Report the held-out figure, not the pooled
one, as the expected skill — and do not
extrapolate beyond those regimes.
